name: Restart venue process
description: Gracefully closes every venue in this JVM and hands off to a successor executable Covia jar. The requesting Job is completed and persisted before shutdown. A helper waits for the old JVM to exit, starts the successor, and starts the current jar as a fallback if the successor does not signal readiness. Omit jar to restart the current version. Venue-owned: requires venue/restart on <venue DID>/process.

jar.description: Successor executable Covia jar. Absolute or relative to the venue process working directory. Omit to restart the current jar.

sha256.description: Optional hex SHA-256 integrity pin for the successor jar.

startupTimeout.description: Milliseconds the helper waits for the successor to finish launching all configured venues before falling back.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the accepted successor bytes; the helper verifies it again before execution.

fallback.description: Current executable jar used if successor startup fails.
